source_text.ISS-0936: Issue ISS-0936 (local record docs/issues/ISS-0936.yaml, queue_ref Q-919, queue task 919, GH#2070; record may not yet be on this branch - PR #2071): scripts/uat_preflight.sh's qa-uat-env credential protocol (fetch_credential, ~line 290) expects the credential source's `token <user>` to print a line `Token: <jwt>`, but ai-dala-infra's qa-uat-env.sh `token <user>` prints a BARE JWT, so every actor login reports NO_PASSWORD. Fix: make fetch_credential accept a bare JWT line (three dot-separated base64url segments) as well as the `Token:` form. Add/adjust tests per project's existing preflight tests (none found under test/ -- TEST-DESIGNER decides a minimal in-repo test shape). Also update the script's header docs (qa-uat-env protocol paragraph) and scripts/README.md if they state the Token: form.

task.description: WF-03 Step 2: design the fix from step-01's diagnosis (read handoffs/WF03-ISS0936-20261001/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json result.summary). Produce a design doc lib/letflow/design/iss0936-uat-preflight-bare-jwt.md (design only, no implementation code beyond short signature/regex illustration): a small pure helper in scripts/uat_preflight.sh's embedded Python (parse_token_line or similar) accepting `Token: <jwt>` OR a full-line bare JWT (three dot-separated base64url segments, require eyJ prefix / min length so hostnames like auth.qa.bizdala.com are rejected), ignoring noise lines, never echoing tokens; header doc paragraph update; test shape (temp fake credential source + tiny scenario dir, UAT_PF_BASH env var because default bash on this host is WSL stub; local stdlib HTTP stub for 200 on GET /api/v1/me/modules optional; asserts: bare JWT not NO_PASSWORD, Token: form still works, noise-only -> NO_PASSWORD, hostname-like line rejected), and WHERE the test lives and how it runs in CI (decide: e.g. a python unittest/ExUnit wrapper under test/ -- check mix.exs/.github workflows to see what CI runs so the test is actually executed). Every acceptance criterion must map to a design element. Work only in context.worktree; do not commit.
